test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 31 July, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct idiom for the word highlighted in bold.

Upon observing the growing popularity of electric vehicles, most conventional car companies chose to **jump on the bandwagon** and launch their own models.

options.text: To make a dangerous leap without thinking.
To follow others in being part of a popular trend.
To let an opportunity pass because of being hesitant.

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"jump on the bandwagon"** is an idiom that means to join others in doing something that is currently popular or trendy. (लोकप्रिय प्रवृत्ति का हिस्सा बनना) • **Example: **When everyone started using social media, many businesses jumped on the bandwagon to promote their products. • In the context of the sentence, it is used to describe how conventional car companies started producing electric vehicles because they became popular. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: To make a dangerous leap without thinking **(बिना सोचे-समझे खतरनाक छलांग लगाना): This does not match the context of the given sentence. • **Example:** He made a dangerous leap into the river without thinking about the strong current. • **Option 3: To let an opportunity pass because of being hesitant **(हिचकिचाहट के कारण अवसर को जाने देना): This does not match the context. • **Example:** She let a great job offer pass because she was too hesitant to move to a new city. • **Option 4: To plan a big parade **(एक बड़ा जुलूस आयोजित करना): This is unrelated to the idiom. • **Example:** The city planned a big parade to celebrate its anniversary. 38:T9b5, The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
